description: Roads is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Statewide Road Network including sealed and unsealed roads. The dataset represents navigable roads, including public and private access roads and tracks. A separate data layer stores 'unformed' DCDB centrelines which do not represent navigable roads. A limited number of associated features are stored separately as point features. Automatically updated when changes occur. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Infrastructure and Transport. Its tags are roads, safety, spatial, tracks, transport. It offers 5 resource(s) in geojson, html, kml, map viewer, shp. The portal shows 2022-07-05 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
